name: sortable-list
title: Sortable List
description: Reorderable rows or tiles on ItemGroup/Item via use-drag-reorder — pointer drag with drop indicators, touch long-press, keyboard move mode, a remove button or a row menu, locked rows, a grid layout with bare tiles for attachments, and server-refusable moves. Controlled; the host owns the order.

meta.whenToUse: User-orderable single lists and tile grids — settings sections, pipeline stages, attribute values with locked built-ins, editable rows with inline actions, ordered product photos and attachments — where the host persists (and may refuse) the order.
meta.whenNotToUse: Cross-container card movement (board), selectable data tables (DataList — never mix selection with reordering), or read-only lists (ItemGroup).
